images.name: s08_arjun_pour_1
images.prompt: An 18-year-old Indian boy with a boyish clean-shaven face, no beard and no moustache, dark brown skin and messy short black hair, slim, wearing a long plain white cotton kurta that reaches his knees with a round collar and no pocket, sleeves rolled up, a red cloth sash tied around his waist and a red string bracelet on his right wrist. He pours chai the traditional way: in his raised right hand a steel tea kettle held high above his head, in his left hand a small glass tumbler held low at waist height, and one thin continuous stream of milky light-brown tea falls straight down from the kettle spout into the glass. Steam rises. He grins and calls out to customers. Behind him his small wooden roadside tea stall with brass pots and small glasses, an evening street in Mumbai with hanging lanterns, shop signs blurred out of focus, and far away above the rooftops a giant glowing blue portal in the sky. Medium shot. No writing anywhere.

images.name: s26_viktor_aura_1
images.prompt: A 28-year-old Western man with a young handsome face, a full head of short slicked-back blonde hair and blue eyes, wearing full modern silver plate armor including steel gauntlets on both hands, and a black cape fastened at both shoulders with round silver clasps. He stands in a dark rocky cave dungeon. A powerful golden aura of energy rises from his whole body like flames and light, filling the air around him with glowing golden sparks, lighting the cave walls gold. His eyes glow yellow. He stares in shock at his own raised gauntleted hands. Medium close-up.
